rawText: The CSV export button spins forever and never downloads anything on Safari 17.

Honestly the new dashboard is gorgeous and loads way faster than before. Great work team!

I was charged twice this month and the invoice doesn't match my plan. Please refund the duplicate.

Your support team got back to me in five minutes and fixed everything. Best support I've had.
